_comment: Stealth config for @playwright/mcp, loaded by this plugin's .mcp.json via --config. PORTABLE DEFAULT: bundled Chromium + headless + JS-level stealth (realistic UA/viewport/locale, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, webdriver init script) — works on headless servers. Requires 'npx playwright install chromium' once.
_maxstealth_hint: For MAXIMUM stealth on a DESKTOP with real Google Chrome + a display, set launchOptions.channel='chrome' and launchOptions.headless=false. Note: channel='chrome' fails if Chrome isn't installed; headless=false needs a display (use xvfb-run on a server).
_note: initScript MUST be a file path (relative to this config), not inline JS — inline strings crash the server with 'Init script file does not exist'.

contextOptions.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
